advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm loops created by `ensure_current_event_loop` on ephemeral/worker threads are not leaked (close-on-teardown or reuse guarantee), since non-fallback paths now install a loop pydantic-ai previously owned.
evidence: Previously only `entered_fallback_model` (fallback path) created a loop; runner text path at src/rebar/llm/runner.py:544 and structured paths (structured_run.py:211,250) now call it unconditionally, so a loop is installed even where `run_sync` previously handled it — with no corresponding close.
ABSENCE: no `loop.close()` for loops the helper creates, and no confirmation these calls always run on a long-lived thread that reuses the loop.
advisory.finding: Loops created by `ensure_current_event_loop()` are never closed. For the plain-text (no fallback) and structured run paths this newly installs a persistent thread loop where pydantic-ai previously managed loop lifecycle internally; on ephemeral/worker threads the created loop is orphaned open, a per-thread resource leak.
scenarios: A run dispatched on a short-lived worker thread that has no prior event loop leaves an open loop bound to the thread after completion.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Close loops created inside the `ensure_current_event_loop` tests (and consider closing the replaced loop in the fixture) to avoid unclosed-loop warnings.
evidence: tests/unit/test_model_classes.py:356: `asyncio.set_event_loop(saved)` — fixture restores but does not close the loop created during the test
advisory.finding: The new helper tests leak open event loops: `test_ensure_current_event_loop_installs_without_deprecation` never closes the loop it creates, and the 'cleared' branch of `test_ensure_current_event_loop_replaces_a_cleared_or_closed_loop` never closes `fresh`; the `_isolated_thread_loop` fixture only `set_event_loop(saved)` without closing the replaced loop.
scenarios: Running the suite emits ResourceWarnings / accumulates unclosed selectors under `-W error` or leak-detecting runners.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that calls ensure_current_event_loop() from within a running loop and asserts it returns asyncio.get_running_loop().
evidence: tests/unit/test_model_classes.py:359-412: the three tests use asyncio.set_event_loop(...) / set_event_loop(None) only — none call ensure_current_event_loop() from inside an async def or a running loop
ABSENCE: search for `get_running_loop` in tests/unit/test_model_classes.py returned (no matches)
advisory.finding: The get_running_loop() early-return branch of ensure_current_event_loop (returns the live running loop when called inside an active event loop) has no test; all three new tests set up the thread loop via set_event_loop and never run the helper from within a running loop, so a regression that returned the installed loop instead of the running loop would go undetected.
scenarios: Helper invoked while an event loop is already running on the calling thread (e.g. from async context)
advisory.suggested_fix: Add an async test (or run the helper inside loop.run_until_complete of a coroutine) asserting `ensure_current_event_loop() is asyncio.get_running_loop()`.
